column3: up with the front pair in 3rd - angled for the rail and began motoring into contention 2f out - hit the front a furlong and a half from home - opened a two length advantage inside the final furlong and stayed on strongly to the line

up with the front group in 5th - up into 4th with three and a half furlongs to run - off the bridle turning into the straight - showed little for the whip a furlong out - stayed on to snatch second close home
went straight to the front - found company entering the straight - lost the advantage to the whip a furlong and a half out - held on for minor honours without finding more in the final furlong
disputed the front in 2nd early - was pressed for it approaching the straight and slipped back to third a furlong and a half out - found no more in the closing stages and held an even gallop
slow into stride and settled at the tail of the field - still 5th turning into the straight - unable to make an impact
up in 4th early - slipped to 5th and pushed along with three and a half furlongs left - already fading in 6th entering the straight - never a threat and beaten a long way out
settled towards the back early - crept into contention 3 out - shared second around the home bend - stormed clear in the run-in for a comfortable success

settled at the back early - closing off the pace from 3 out - went with the front pair after 2 out - rallied after the last to grab second inside the final furlong - unable to peg back the winner close home

sent to the front early - sketchy at the first and dictated an even gallop - squeezed for effort when overtaken soon after the last - no answer to the winner's turn of foot in the run-in - faded to surrender second close home
handy with the pace-setters - moved into second and narrowed the gap on the front-runner after 2 out before coming under pressure approaching the last - faded fast in the run-in
settled at the back early - made a little progress after 2f out - lost touch before the last and faded in the run-in
raced in mid-division - asked for effort after 2 out - found little and dropped well behind before the last
raced in mid-division before slipping towards the back by the 4th - off the pace before 2 out - beaten a long way and pulled up before the last
up with the pace early - travelled wide of the field the whole way - blundered at the 5th - slipped back 3 out - soon beaten to the back and faded after 2 out

sat behind the front-runners - fourth at halfway - driven along in fourth 3f out and made ground 2f out - went for the lead inside the final furlong as the tack shifted - lost both stirrups in the final 100 yards - veered left near the finish - in a scrap for the lead near home and bumped late on - denied by a whisker at the line but promoted to the win

settled towards the back early - headway 4f out - up into third 3f out - narrowed the gap 2f out - hit the front over 1f out - driven along and challenged hard inside the final furlong - veered left and was collared near the finish - got there right on the line but demoted to second
settled towards the back - made headway into fifth 3f out - driven and up to fourth entering the final furlong - ran on without finding another gear to the line
raced close up early - hit the front 3f out - driven along and overtaken approaching the final furlong - found nothing more and continued at the same gear through the final furlong
made the running from the start - driven along and passed 3f out - had nothing more entering the straight
settled towards the back - made headway into sixth 3f out - driven and made further ground 2f out - found nothing more and continued at one gear over the final furlong
raced up with the pace and third at halfway - driven along and found nothing from 3f out - faded and came home well beaten
raced in the pack early - niggled along at halfway - driven along in fifth 4f out - soon had nothing more and faded away to finish a long way behind
settled early - niggled along after 8f - in the pack at halfway - driven along and found nothing from 4f out before dropping a long way behind
racing in the pack - driven along and found nothing 4f out - faded and finished a long way behind

raced handy early - drifted markedly left on the turn after 3f - soon back in the pack - wandered left again and ran wide off the turn 7f out - soon towards the back and losing touch before dropping a long way behind
well placed in second and closing on the pace-setter 4 out - went on 3 out - urged forward before 2 out - driven out to score comfortably run-in
settled towards the back - improved to third under pressure before 2 out - stayed on in pursuit of the pacesetter before the last - no extra run-in beaten five and a half lengths into second
sat close up behind the front-runners - asked for effort after 3 out and found little when driven approaching 2 out - showed no more to the line beaten nine and a half lengths in third
made the running - came under pressure 4 out before being overtaken and driven 3 out - weakened quickly soon after beaten fourteen and a quarter lengths in fourth
settled in the centre of the field and clipped the first - driven along before 2 out - found nothing to the line beaten twenty three and three-quarter lengths in fifth
raced in touch with the front-runners - jumped raggedly 3 out - faded softly before 2 out beaten thirty two and three-quarter lengths in sixth
held up towards the back of the field - jumped awkwardly at the 2nd - denied a clear run and unseated rider on the bend after 3 out
sent straight to the front - three lengths to the good in the final furlong despite being niggled along - found more to the line

up with the front pair in 3rd - opened up on the rest of the field when pushed along three furlongs out - began to motor two furlongs out - up into second with the rider driving along but unable to find more and held an even gallop to the line

made the running early - sat close up in second and pushed along before the straight - put up a short-lived bid for it with the rider driving two furlongs out - held third without finding more approaching the furlong marker
settled off the pace early - 5th at halfway and dropped away in 4th three and a half furlongs out - made no show in the straight
raced in 4th behind the front group early - slipped to 5th and needed the whip three and a half furlongs out - soon lost touch and offered no threat
raced in 5th behind the front group - last and needed the whip at halfway - lost more ground four furlongs out - never a threat and well beaten

settled at the back early - briefly last before the 3rd - urged into contention after 2 out - going nicely to share the front turning for home - hit the front approaching the last then shaken up to open up in the run-in - coasted to the line for a comfortable success
soon settled in third - found in front 2 out - put under pressure when pressed before the last - overtaken approaching the last and faded in the run-in
settled at the back - improving into third 2 out - no match for the front two before the last and faded in the run-in
soon travelling in second - hit the front for a moment when hampered by a fallen rival 2 out - soon overtaken and beaten to the back before fading before the last
made the running - four lengths to the good when fell 3 out

soon vying for the front - in front before the 2nd - opened a big gap from the 3rd - minor mistake at the 6th - six lengths to the good at halfway - that margin narrowed by the 8th - stretched away once more before 4 out - further mistakes at 3 out and 2 out - another mistake at the last and driven along - flat out and got home narrowly late on

raced up with the pace - fifth at halfway - up to third with a minor mistake 3 out - driven into second but unable to reach the front-runner before 2 out - rallied and made further ground at the last - finished strongly to the line but narrowly beaten
racing in the pack - driven up into sixth after 3 out - found nothing to threaten in fifth at the following fence and continued at one speed
raced up handy behind the front group - sketchy at the 2nd - sixth at halfway - driven into third after 3 out - soon unable to threaten those in front and continued at one speed
went to the front in company early - overtaken before the 2nd - second at halfway - driven along and unable to threaten after 3 out - found nothing more in third 2 out before fading
towards the back early - in the pack at halfway - made headway into fifth 3 out then driven along without finding more before the following fence
held up towards the back - driven along without threatening after 3 out - continued at one speed before a modest third at the last
held up towards the back - driven along without threatening 4 out - at no stage in contention
raced up with the front group - fourth at halfway - driven along without finding more 3 out
settled early - towards the back at halfway - driven along without threatening after 3 out
in the pack - driven along towards the back 3 out - faded and was soon pulled up
towards the back - niggled at halfway - made a mistake at the 9th then faded and was pulled up before 4 out
went to the front in company early - overtaken before the 2nd - third at halfway - driven along without finding more before 3 out - faded and was pulled up before the last
held towards the back for most of the way - driven along without finding more 4 out and began to fade - pulled up before the last
in the pack early - soon towards the back - niggled at halfway - driven hard without finding more 4 out - faded and was pulled up before the last

settled at the back of the field - began to make progress after 3 out and moved into second approaching 2 out - edged left under pressure but hit the front before the last - kept on strongly to win run-in

settled towards the back - advanced into fourth by the 7th - asked for effort before 2 out and stayed on but edged right run-in - unable to challenge the winner beaten two and three-quarter lengths in second

made the running - jumped raggedly at the 7th and again 4 out - asked for effort before 2 out and lost the advantage after being bumped before the last - ran on without finding more beaten three lengths in third
raced close to the leading duo - asked for effort 2 out - kept on at one speed run-in beaten eight lengths in fourth
raced close to the pace early - asked for effort after 3 out - soon lost touch beaten twenty three lengths in fifth
raced in the centre of the field before dropping towards the back by the 7th - asked for effort after 3 out - faded 2 out beaten twenty six lengths in sixth
raced in the centre of the field - asked for effort before 2 out - still in contention when fell at the final flight
raced close to the pace - hit the front after three furlongs - held a slender lead and drifted a touch right approaching the furlong marker before staying on strongly

settled last of all - began to make headway before the straight - up into 5th and starting to motor with two furlongs left - into 4th and putting the leader under pressure a furlong out - up into second 100 yards from home and looked the likely winner in the final strides - stayed on to the line

sat close up in 4th early - up into second with five furlongs left - pushed along before the straight - put up a bid for the lead with two furlongs to run - back to third and squeezed for room with the rider driving a furlong out but held a steady gallop

raced behind the front group - 7th at halfway - made ground entering the straight - up into third and threatening the lead two furlongs out - second with the rider driving a furlong out and looked sure to be involved at the finish - held on for fourth without quickening

sat close up in third early - 4th with five furlongs left - began to motor entering the straight - back to 5th and driven along over a furlong out without making an impact - held an even gallop inside the final furlong
settled towards the back early - 9th at halfway - made headway two furlongs out - back to 6th and driven along a furlong out without making an impact
settled towards the back and pushed along by halfway - made headway two furlongs out - driven along for 7th without making an impact in the final furlong
raced behind the front group - 6th at halfway - dropped away two furlongs out and soon out of contention
pushed along from an early stage - settled towards the back - 8th at halfway - made no impact when driven along two furlongs out and soon dropped away
sat close up in 5th early - dropped away when driven along two furlongs out - soon well beaten
made the running for three furlongs - settled in behind in second - 3rd with five furlongs left - dropped away two furlongs out - soon beaten and never a threat
raced in mid-division - narrowed the gap on the front-runners 2 out - moved into second around the home bend before hitting the front soon after the last - driven out for the win
up with the pace - hit the front 2 out - going easily until a serious blunder at the last - soon overtaken - pursued the winner in the run-in but found nothing more close home
handy with the pace-setters - improved position at the 11th - no answer to the front two before the last and faded in the run-in
settled at the back - made a little progress before 2 out - pressed for effort around the home bend - mistake at the last and faded in the run-in
up with the pace - urged forward 2 out - found wanting and driven before the last before fading in the run-in
settled at the back - mistake at the 4th - slipped to last 3 out - responded with a little renewed effort before the last but faded in the run-in

made the running - soon opened a four length advantage - shed the advantage after a sluggish leap at the first - dictated a steady gallop - overtaken 3 out and found lacking after 2f out - soon faded and beaten a long way before the last
went forward and shared the front early - took it up before 2 out - driven out to go clear after 2 out and stayed on strongly to the line
soon raced up with the front group - third at halfway - driven along before 2 out - second at the last unable to threaten the winner and continued at one speed
settled early - soon towards the back - driven into seventh before 2 out - up to sixth entering the straight and stayed on well up the run-in
raced close to the front early - in a scrap for the lead after the 3rd - driven along in second before 2 out - found nothing more in third at the last and continued at one gear
raced in behind the front group - sixth at halfway - driven along after 3 out - pushed along in fourth 2 out and continued at one gear from before the last
settled early - in the pack at halfway - made headway into sixth before 2 out - driven along in fifth without threatening entering the straight and continued at one gear
towards the back - driven along before 2 out - unable to threaten in seventh entering the straight and continued at one gear
settled towards the back - made headway before 2 out - driven along in eighth entering the straight without threatening
raced up with the front group - fourth at halfway - in touch with a minor error 4 out then driven along without finding more 2 out
settled early - travelled wide and sat in the pack at intervals - driven along without threatening 2 out
settled towards the back - made headway into sixth 4 out - driven along without finding more before 2 out
in the pack - driven along without finding more after 3 out - faded
settled early - towards the back and made a mistake at the 7th - faded 3 out and came home a long way behind
raced up with the front group - minor mistake at the 3rd - fifth at halfway - driven along without finding more after 3 out and pulled up before the following fence
in the pack for most of the way - driven along without finding more after 3 out - pulled up before the following fence
close behind the pace-setter - hit the front before the 14th - asked for effort before the last - found more to score readily run-in
raced close up on the inside - asked for effort before 2 out - kept on run-in without threatening the winner beaten six and a half lengths in second
raced in the centre of the field - asked for effort at the 14th - stayed on into third run-in without getting competitive beaten nineteen and a half lengths

settled towards the back and clipped the 8th - made headway before the 13th and up to third soon after - in touch with the pace-setter before 2 out - driven before the last and lost place beaten twenty and three-quarter lengths in fourth
raced in the centre of the field - asked for effort before 3 out - found nothing and faded before the last beaten twenty nine and a quarter lengths in fifth
settled towards the back and racing in the centre of the field by the 6th - blundered at the 12th and slipped further back - soon detached and pulled up before 3 out
made the running - lost the advantage before the 14th with a mistake there - stayed in touch with the pace-setter - blundered 3 out and soon pulled up

up in second early - 3rd and pushed along with three furlongs left - put in a bid for it with the rider driving two furlongs out - shared the front with a furlong to run - stayed on strongly and edged in front 50 yards out - saw it out to the line

settled towards the back - 12th at halfway - made headway entering the straight - up into 4th and pressing for the lead a furlong out - stayed on strongly for the whip - grabbed second in the final strides but came up short

sat close up in 4th - up into second and pressing for it two furlongs out - shared the front with a furlong to run - stayed on - lost the advantage for the whip 50 yards out and dropped to third in the final strides
raced behind the front group - 6th at halfway and 7th with three furlongs left - made no impact when driven along two furlongs out - held an even gallop from over a furlong out
sat close up in 5th - 6th with three furlongs left - pushed along two furlongs out - made no impact for the whip over a furlong out and held an even gallop
set the pace - was joined by a rival two furlongs out - lost the advantage for the whip a furlong out and found nothing more
settled in the pack early - 10th at halfway - made ground entering the straight and up to 8th with two furlongs left - 7th at the finish without making an impact for the whip
settled in the pack - 7th at halfway - made ground three furlongs out and up to 5th and motoring with two furlongs left - found no more for the whip a furlong out
hesitant to begin and settled towards the back - made headway two furlongs out - 8th at the finish without making an impact for the whip
settled at the back of the field throughout - made no impact from two furlongs out - was not seen with a chance at any stage
settled in the pack - 9th at halfway - dropped away for the whip two furlongs out and soon beaten
up in 3rd early - up into second and pushed along with three furlongs left - dropped away for the whip two furlongs out and soon beaten
settled towards the back early - 8th at halfway - made no impact two furlongs out and soon dropped away
settled in the pack early - 11th at halfway - dropped away entering the straight - soon beaten and never a threat
soon travelling in second - reeled in the front-runner after 2 out - shared the front at the last - edged in front in the run-in and prevailed by a whisker at the line

soon made the running - opened a three length advantage after the 2nd before stretching the gap before 3 out - saw the advantage cut after 2 out and caught at the last - soon overtaken in the run-in - kept on grimly for second under pressure from the winner close home
settled at the back - improved into third after the 2nd - found little from 3 out and dropped away to be well beaten before the last
settled at the back - beaten a long way from 3 out
soon travelling in third behind the front-runners - beaten to the back by the 3rd - well beaten and pulled up before 3 out

in the pack early - sixth at halfway - made headway 2 out - driven into fourth entering the straight - in a scrap for the lead among rivals at the last - soon went to the front and stayed on strongly to the line

in the pack early - made ground on the front group after the 3rd - fifth at halfway - driven into a scrap for the lead before 2 out - edged in front 2 out - caught and soon passed at the last - continued at one speed

in the pack - made headway after 3 out - into a scrap for the lead before 2 out - a minor mistake at 2 out and driven along - pushed along in third entering the straight - pressed for the front at the last but found nothing more up the run-in

settled in the pack - made ground into sixth before 2 out - driven to attack for the front entering the straight - in a short-lived scrap for the lead at the last - found nothing more up the run-in and continued at one gear
raced up with the front group - fourth at halfway - driven along without threatening 2 out - found nothing more in sixth entering the straight and continued at one gear
settled towards the back - travelled wide - made ground into seventh before 2 out - driven along without threatening 2 out and continued at one gear
went to the front in company early - driven along and overtaken before 2 out - found nothing more entering the straight and faded
settled towards the back - driven into eighth before 2 out - soon unable to threaten
raced up with the front group early - into the pack after the 3rd - driven along and faded before 2 out then pulled up before the last
spent the race towards the tail of the field - made no impact and dropped away before 2 out - pulled up before the last
raced up with the front group early - soon into the pack - towards the back and driven along 3 out - soon faded and was pulled up before 2 out
soon racing close to the front - in a scrap for the lead at halfway - a minor mistake 3 out - driven along and faded before 2 out then pulled up before the last
held up towards the back throughout - faded 3 out - dropped away and pulled up approaching 2 out

into a scrap for the lead early - sat close to the front from the 2nd - third at halfway - back contesting the front with a minor mistake 3 out - soon driven along without finding more before fading and being pulled up before 2 out
tracked the pace - driven 2 out and battled on bravely in a prolonged fight for the lead - edged ahead in the final strides to win run-in

settled towards the back - made strong progress on the outside after 3 out - nosed in front 2 out and fought on gamely in a prolonged battle - driven out but overtaken in the final strides beaten three tenths of a length into second
settled towards the back - made headway before 2 out to contest third - driven run-in and kept on but boxed in behind the leading two approaching the finish beaten one and a half lengths in third

raced in the centre of the field - made ground under pressure before 2 out to contest third - soon driven - kept on run-in but lacked the speed to get involved beaten one and three-quarter lengths in fourth

raced close to the pace on the outside - asked for effort before 2 out - kept on and still holding a winning position at the last - driven by hand after dropping the stick but found no more in the final furlong beaten two lengths in fifth
tracked the front-runners while pulling hard early - asked for effort before the last - found no more run-in beaten three and a half lengths in sixth
settled towards the back of the pack - asked for effort after 4 out - unable to make ground 2 out beaten seven and a quarter lengths in seventh
made the running - driven before 2 out and overtaken nearing there - faded fast beaten twenty eight and a quarter lengths in eighth
raced close up behind the front-runners - asked for effort and lost ground before 2 out - soon pulled up

sent to the front from the break - lost that spot after two furlongs and raced in second - back in front with two furlongs to run - a length to the good with the rider driving a furlong out - drifted a shade left but stayed on strongly to the line

up in second early - hit the front after two furlongs - pushed along before the straight - lost the front with two furlongs to run - settled for the runner-up spot - found nothing more for the whip over a furlong out but stayed on
sat close up in 4th - up to third and pushed along in the straight - made no impact for the whip two furlongs out but stayed on from over a furlong out
raced behind the front group - 5th at halfway and made ground entering the straight - made no impact two furlongs out and held an even gallop
sat close up in 3rd - back to 4th and pushed along entering the straight - found nothing more for the whip two furlongs out
settled in the pack - 7th at halfway - made ground entering the straight and up to 6th with two furlongs left - made no impact in the final furlong
settled in the pack - 8th at halfway - made headway entering the straight and up to 7th with two furlongs left - made no impact in the final furlong
raced behind the front group - 6th at halfway - dropped away entering the straight and soon beaten
hesitant to begin and settled towards the back - made no impact entering the straight - was not a threat at any stage
in no hurry to begin - settled at the back throughout - pushed along early - last and losing more ground entering the straight - soon beaten and never a threat

made the running before being overtaken at the 5th - back in front by the 11th - took command around the home bend - soon opened up an advantage and was untroubled in the run-in - driven out for the verdict
settled at the back - began closing from 3 out - moved into second after 2 out - pursued the winner before the last but unable to close the gap in the run-in
handy early - pursued the front-runners from 3 out - no match for the front two after 2 out and stayed on at one speed after the last
up with the pace - hit the front at the 5th - overtaken at the 11th - found lacking after 2 out and faded before the last

settled at the back - began improving at the 13th - drifted right and bumped another runner 4 out - moved into second 3 out - surrendered a position 2 out and faded at the last - slipped to fifth in the run-in
no higher than mid-division - made a mistake when hampered and unseated the rider at the 14th
up with the pace - soon travelling in second - shipping distance after a mistake at the 4th - adrift after sketchy jumping at the 7th and 8th before being soon pulled up
raced in mid-division - sketchy at the 3rd - mistake at the 8th and beaten to the back by the 14th before being pulled up before 2 out
sent forward and set the pace - went clear approaching 2 out - stumbled last and driven out - margin cut but battled on well
settled towards the back early - briefly bumped 3rd - in the chasing pack at halfway - improved into 5th and driven up to 4th before 2 out - 3rd and stumbled at the last - rallied well to the line
settled just behind the pace in 2nd - still 2nd at halfway - driven along approaching 2 out - stumbled at the last but battled on to the line
settled off the pace early - made headway into 5th at halfway - driven up into 3rd approaching 2 out - found nothing more in 4th before the last but stuck on to the line
in the pack early - made headway towards the front from 3rd - 3rd at halfway - driven into 4th before 2 out - found nothing more in 5th and never picked up again
settled towards the back - clumsy at the 1st - briefly bumped 3rd - moved through the pack before 3 out - driven along in 6th before 2 out and soon found nothing more
close to the pace early - stumbled 2nd - in the pack after that - stumbled again 5th - hesitant 4 out and driven along but found nothing more before 2 out
settled off the pace - bumped 3rd and slipped towards the back - driven along passing 3 out but found nothing more
held up towards the back - driven along and found nothing passing 3 out - soon run out of steam
racing in the pack - driven along with nothing more to offer before 2 out - faded
close up early - 4th at halfway - improved into 2nd before 4 out and stumbled there - driven along with nothing more before 2 out and pulled up before the last
racing in the pack early - making headway towards the front when fell at the 3rd

raced in the centre of the field before moving closer to the pace by the 2nd - made ground on the leading group 4 out - went to the front 3 out travelling strongly - increased the advantage before the last - driven out and ran on strongly to win run-in

settled towards the back and made a mistake at the 2nd - jumped raggedly at the 7th - up into fourth after another mistake 3 out - soon driven - kept on to take second run-in but never able to land a blow on the winner beaten ten lengths
made the running - lost the advantage 3 out and driven - stayed on without ever threatening beaten eleven and three-quarter lengths in third

raced close up behind the front-runners - up into second by the 4th - asked for effort after 4 out but slipped back a place then driven 3 out - kept on at one gear beaten twelve and three-quarter lengths in fourth
close to the pace early and in fourth from the 4th - found for speed 4 out and dropped away - toiling 3 out and beaten ninety eight and three-quarter lengths in fifth
raced close up behind the front-runners before dropping towards the back by the 2nd - asked for effort 4 out - soon detached and pulled up after 3 out

settled towards the back of the pack - 8th at halfway - made ground two furlongs out - up to 4th and put in a bid for it with the rider driving a furlong out - hit the front 150 yards out and stayed on strongly to the line
sat close up in second - put in a bid for it two furlongs out - hit the front for the whip a furlong out - lost that spot 150 yards out but stayed on
sat close up in 4th - made ground two furlongs out - up to third and put up a bid for the lead a furlong out staying on for the whip at an even gallop
went straight to the front - lost the advantage for the whip a furlong out - stayed on at an even gallop
raced behind the front group - 6th at halfway - made ground two furlongs out - made no impact for the whip a furlong out and held an even gallop
sat close up in 3rd - put up a bid for the lead two furlongs out - back to 5th and found nothing more for the whip a furlong out
sat close up in 5th - dropped away for the whip two furlongs out - made no impact
settled towards the back - 10th at halfway - made headway two furlongs out before making no impact
slow into stride and settled in the pack - 7th at halfway - pushed along two furlongs out - made no impact
settled towards the back of the pack - 9th at halfway - made headway two furlongs out before making no impact
settled at the back early - last and pushed along at halfway - soon beaten and never a threat
up with the pace - urged forward in pursuit of the front-runner after 2 out - driven to the front at the last - took command in the run-in - drew clear for an emphatic success
up with the pace - reeled in the front-runners 4 out - hit the front 3 out - under pressure when overtaken at the last - found second best in the run-in and faded close home
made the running - caught at the 2nd - regained the front 4 out - mistake and overtaken 3 out - run out of contention before the last but battled on for third
settled at the back - sketchy at the 3rd - mistake and urged forward at the 6th - found lacking after 3 out and off the pace before the last
settled at the back - sketchy at the first - slipped to last and urged forward after the 7th - well beaten after 3 out and pulled up before 2 out
up with the pace - shared the front at the 2nd - mistake at the 5th - sketchy at the 7th - found wanting and slipped back 4 out before fading fast and being pulled up before 3 out
battling for the front early - went clear after 2 out - stumbled at the last but driven out and held on strongly
close up early - 3rd at halfway - driven along approaching 2 out - held for 2nd without closing at the last and stayed on at one level
close up early - 4th at halfway - driven along after 3 out - found nothing more soon after and ran on at one level from the last

close up early and sharing the front before the 2nd - hesitant there and lost the advantage - stumbled 4th - renewed the challenge 4 out and contested the front again nearing 2 out - soon driven and lost the front once more - found nothing more in 3rd at the last and stayed on at just one gear
settled towards the back - driven into 5th entering the straight - found nothing more in 4th at the last and stayed on at one level
close up early - stumbled 4th - 5th at halfway - driven along before 3 out but found nothing more before 2 out
settled off the pace - towards the back 3 out - driven along and found nothing soon after

made the running but was sluggish at the 1st - lost the advantage before the 4th but stayed in touch - asked for effort and left in second before 2 out where nosed back in front nearing there - driven before the last - found more and drew clear run-in to win

raced close up behind the pace-setting duo - took over before 2 out under pressure but lost that position nearing there - kept on and well placed until a mistake at the last and unable to fight back beaten three and a quarter lengths in second
settled towards the back - asked for effort at the 6th - stayed on for a distant third beaten twenty five and a quarter lengths
raced close up behind the front-runners - asked for effort before 2 out and faded fast beaten twenty nine and a quarter lengths in fourth
raced close up in second - jumped raggedly at the 3rd - went to the front before the following fence - jumped poorly again 4 out and soon pulled up before 2 out

raced behind the front group - a modest 6th at halfway - made ground over a furlong out - up into second for the whip inside the final 100 yards - stayed on strongly to hit the front in the final strides

quick away and sent straight to the front - soon opened a healthy advantage - three lengths to the good approaching the furlong marker - stayed on for the whip but lost the advantage in the closing strides

settled off the pace - a modest 8th at halfway - made headway but was short of room for a spell a furlong out - was angled left soon after - stayed on for the whip - up to third 50 yards out but could not get to the front two
